title: Shrine of the Eternal Flame
description: A shrine carved from black volcanic stone stands untouched by the devastation around it, an eternal flame dancing atop its altar without fuel or wick. The air here is still and reverent, free of the choking ash that blankets everything else. At the base of the flame, a magma core pulses with deep, slow light.

choices.label: Pray at the shrine
choices.description: Kneel before the flame and feel its warmth mend body and spirit.

outcomes.text: The flame flares gently as you kneel. Warmth floods through your party — not the searing heat of the wastes, but something deeper and kinder.
A faint voice whispers from the flame: 'Your path burns bright.' The warmth is mild but calming.
The flame dims as you approach, as if judging you. It offers nothing. Perhaps you are found wanting.

choices.label: Offer gold to the flame
choices.description: Cast coins into the fire as tribute. The flame flares and its healing warmth intensifies.

outcomes.text: The coins melt instantly, and the flame erupts in a pillar of golden light. Every wound and ache in your party vanishes in the radiance.
The flame consumes your offering and pulses warmly. Healing light washes over the party, though it fades quickly.
The flame accepts your gold but gives only a flicker of warmth in return. The shrine's power seems diminished.

choices.label: Take the magma core
choices.description: Seize the pulsing magma core from beneath the altar flame.

outcomes.text: You snatch the core and the flame gutters violently. The shrine goes dark, but the magma core throbs with captured power in your hands.
As you wrench the core free, the flame lashes out like a living thing. Burns sear your arms, but you hold on. The shrine crumbles.
The flame detonates the moment you touch the altar. Sacred fire engulfs the shrine and blasts your party backward. When the smoke clears, the core is cracked and dim — but a shard of it survived.
